properties.entry: SELECT CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN, ID_TAREA, FECHA_INICIO, FECHA_FIN HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT COD_TIPO_HORA FROM TAREA_TIPO_HORA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY COD_TIPO_HORA HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_PERSONA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_PERSONA_ESTRUCTURA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_PRESENCIA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND CCL_ID_SECCION != :idSeccion
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_PERSONA_PRESENCIA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND CCL_ID_SECCION != :idSeccion
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_VENTA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND CCL_ID_SECCION != :idSeccion

SELECT * FROM TAREA_PERSONA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND ((STD_ID_HR IS NULL OR STD_ID_HR = '') OR (CCL_ID_PERSON IS NULL OR CCL_ID_PERSON = '') OR (CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN IS NULL OR CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN = '') OR (STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT IS NULL OR STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT = '') OR (FECHA_FIN IS NULL ) OR (FECHA_INICIO IS NULL ) OR (STD_OR_HR_PERIOD IS NULL OR STD_OR_HR_PERIOD = '') OR (ID_TAREA IS NULL ))

WITH TABLAS AS (SELECT STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT AS LOCALIZACION, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_AMBITO_LOCALIZACION WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT UNION ALL SELECT STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT AS LOCALIZACION, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT) SELECT LOCALIZACION, ROW_COUNT FROM TABLAS GROUP BY LOCALIZACION, ROW_COUNT HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2

WITH TABLAS AS (SELECT CCL_ID_PERSON AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_AMBITO_PERSONA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY CCL_ID_PERSON UNION ALL SELECT CCL_ID_PERSON AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_PERSONA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY CCL_ID_PERSON) SELECT NAME, ROW_COUNT FROM TABLAS GROUP BY NAME, ROW_COUNT HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2

WITH TABLAS AS (SELECT STD_ID_LEG_ENT AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY STD_ID_LEG_ENT UNION ALL SELECT STD_ID_LEG_ENT AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY STD_ID_LEG_ENT) SELECT NAME FROM TABLAS GROUP BY NAME HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2
